description: This Kotlin source file defines a Navigator class that manages fragment transactions and navigation within an Android application's MainActivity, specifically handling fragment transitions via supportFragmentManager.

classes.name: Navigator
classes.description: A class responsible for handling fragment navigation and back stack management within an Android activity.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a specified fragment, optionally adding the transaction to the back stack with fade-in and fade-out animations.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Performs a back navigation action, popping the fragment back stack if possible.
